certificates.description: Read-only. The signing certificates contained in the .p12 file. A single .p12 can bundle several independent certificates (for example a development and a distribution one), so this is always an array. The entries keep the order the .p12 itself stores them in (its ASN.1 sequence order) and are not re-sorted. Computed server-side once the file is processed; never null, but empty until then or when the extraction failed.

expiry_date.description: Read-only. This certificate's notAfter date in RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 (UTC). Computed server-side once the file is processed; null when it could not be extracted from the certificate.

serial.description: Read-only. X.509 serial number of this certificate, rendered as uppercase hexadecimal. Computed server-side once the file is processed; null when it could not be extracted from the certificate.

file_sha256.description: Read-only. SHA-256 hash of the uploaded file bytes, rendered as lowercase hexadecimal. Computed server-side once the file is processed; null until then.

next.description:
Next is the "anchor" for pagination. This value should be passed to the same endpoint
to get the next page. Empty/not included if there's no "next" page.
Stop paging when there's no "Next" item in the response!

page_item_limit.description:
PageItemLimit - per-page item count. A given page might include
less items if there's not enough items. This value is the "max item count per page".

total_item_count.description: TotalItemCount - total item count, through "all pages"
